The 'Limbs' checkpoint was marked present despite low visibility; however, the visible forelimb structure is anatomically plausible (short/stout), so this is acceptable. The 'Head' and 'Body' checkpoints are correctly verified.
artifact_review: The Router identified a 'texture_anomaly' (severity 2) under the right forelimb. The Perceptual Quality Auditor noted only slight blur. I agree with the Router that the rock texture smearing is a minor grounding issue (likely severity 2). The Animal Pose Auditor showed low confidence in limb keypoints (ratio ~24%), which aligns with the visual difficulty of resolving short amphibian limbs against a complex background, rather than catastrophic structural failure. No new severe artifacts were found.

The deduction from a perfect 5.0 is due to the lack of fine detail in the eyes (missing iris flecks) and the slight ambiguity in limb digit definition, though no gross anatomical errors exist.
